name: TameBoy
source:
Main character works with cat-boys Futaba and Wakaba. Protagonist may choose to pursue any of them. The ending will depend on the choices during night time changing "sensitivity" and "pleasure" parameters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与猫耳男孩Futaba和Wakaba一起工作。玩家可以选择追求其中任何一人。结局取决于夜间选择，以及会改变“敏感度”和“快感”参数的行动。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
